; REQ: LANG-611 LANG-612 LANG-613 LANG-614
#| Block comment
   #| nested |# still a comment |#
(define (square x) (* x x))

(define (greet name times)
  (let loop ((i 0) (acc ""))
    (if (< i times)
        (loop (+ i 1) (string-append acc "Hello, " name "!\n"))
        acc)))

(define-record-type point
  (make-point x y)
  point?
  (x point-x))

(display (greet "world" 2))
(newline)
(define flags (list #t #f #true 'symbol #\a #\space))
(when (and (pair? flags) (not (null? flags)))
  (display (map square '(1 2 3))))
(set! flags (cons 1.5 flags))
